title: Copied object name
description:
Layout-quality rule — a named layout object carries a copy suffix (' Copy', ' Kopie'), a numeric paste suffix, or shares its name with another object on the same layout. Named objects are referenced by scripts and calculations, so leftover copy names hit the wrong object or none at all. Numeric suffixes can also be deliberate naming — verify before renaming.

Based on the fmCheckMate check "Copied Object Name" — https://github.com/mrwatson-de/fmCheckMate-XSLT
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: FileMaker appends a copy suffix when pasting a named object onto the same layout. Named objects are referenced by scripts and calculations — a leftover copy name either hijacks a reference or breaks it.
rule.remediation: Rename or delete the copied object. Numeric suffixes can be deliberate naming — verify against the referencing scripts before renaming.
